answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the yarrow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the atlas of the next round.
